notes_purge_idx.name: notes_purge_idx
notes_purge_idx.where: "notes"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL AND "notes"."purged_at" IS NULL

notes_purge_shape.name: notes_purge_shape
notes_purge_shape.value: "notes"."purge_after" IS NULL OR "notes"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL

shares_grantee_shape.name: shares_grantee_shape
shares_grantee_shape.value: ("shares"."grantee_kind" = 'user' AND "shares"."grantee_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shares"."token_hash" IS NULL) OR ("shares"."grantee_kind" = 'link' AND "shares"."grantee_user_id" IS NULL AND "shares"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND octet_length("shares"."token_hash") = 32)

ws_shape.name: ws_shape
ws_shape.value: ("workspaces"."kind" = 'personal' AND "workspaces"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."org_id" IS NULL AND "workspaces"."team_id" IS NULL) OR ("workspaces"."kind" = 'team' AND "workspaces"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspaces"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)
